verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is an API account endpoint that returns sending addresses with their verification and DMARC status. That is a read-only status field, not a documented, guided SPF/DKIM/DMARC domain-authentication flow with DNS setup and verification, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
